title: History Is About to Be Made (The Post-Midterm Rally Starts on THIS Date)
creator: MarketBeat
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions; note: captions garble several names (Chaikin, Veeva, Zscaler, Fortinet) in places
summary: MarketBeat host Bridget interviews guest Mark Chaikin of Chaikin Analytics about the post-midterm sell-off: the S&P 500 fell 4.4% and the Nasdaq 100 fell 5.5% on the Thursday after the elections, with the VIX spiking above 25. Chaikin attributes the rout to fears that a new Democratic governor in Texas would slow AI data-center buildout, and argues the selling was driven by machines rather than institutions. He presents history as the case for buying: in the 56 instances since 1950 when the S&P fell more than 4% in a day, the average gain three months later was about 6.5%, versus about 2.5% normally, and the Nasdaq 100 showed a similar pattern in 19 instances since 1999. The post-midterm strength, he says, begins just before Thanksgiving. His three BUYs are Shopify (SHOP, under $140 from an October peak near $180; strong 3 November earnings and smart money accumulating), Veeva Systems (VEEV, only about 7% off its high; the largest pharma data database feeding drug companies' AI models, analysts raising estimates, last earnings jumping the stock from $240 to $285) and Zscaler (ZS, about $195 from $260, a roughly 25% discount in seven days; cloud security critical to the AI rollout, and smart money buying dips). CrowdStrike and Fortinet are discussed only as weaker comparisons to Zscaler, with no explicit call. Much of the video promotes Chaikin's free webinar on Wednesday 11 November at 10am ET, promising hidden-gem tickers and a $10 trillion post-election opportunity.
